prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 15 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Edit Video 1: Turn the two capybaras into capybara versions of the two people from the photos. The capybara on the RIGHT with the pink bow (the grumpy one who gets hugged) becomes the capybara version of the person in [Image 1]. The capybara on the LEFT with the green bow tie (the one who hugs) becomes the capybara version of the person in [Image 2]. Only their look changes; the bed, the bedroom, the lamp light, the moves, the faces they pull, the timing, the cuts and the camera stay completely unchanged. Keep everything else the same.

References: [Image 1] is the sole look reference for the capybara on the RIGHT, [Image 2] for the capybara on the LEFT; [Video 1] is for the moves, the expressions and the camera only. Each one stays a cute 3D cartoon capybara with a capybara head, snout, round fur body and paws, in the same soft animated style as the video: never a human face, never human skin. It wears its person's look, so their friends recognize them at once: the exact hairstyle, hair length and hair color from its photo as real hair on top of the capybara head, the person's eye color and eyebrow shape, a fur tone close to their skin tone, and any glasses, beard, moustache, freckles, earrings or piercings from the photo. Instead of the bow from the video it wears a soft pajama top in the colors and pattern of the clothes in its photo. If a photo shows an animal, that one is that animal itself in the same cute 3D style, with its own face, fur colors and markings. Both change: neither keeps the plain look of the video, also in the wide shots and when a head turns away. NO pink bow and NO green bow tie unless a photo shows them. Never blend the two looks, never swap their places.

The shots, matching [Video 1] second by second:
Shot 1 [0-4.1s]: a cozy bedroom at night with a warm bedside lamp, a wide shot of the bed: the one on the LEFT smiles; the one on the RIGHT gives a grumpy side-eye, huffs and slides lower under the duvet, turning away.
Shot 2 [4.1-6.4s]: hard cut, close-up of the one on the LEFT: the smile softens into a tender, slightly worried look.
Shot 3 [6.4-9.2s]: hard cut, close-up of the one on the RIGHT on the pillow, frowning and pouting, the other one soft in the background.
Shot 4 [9.2-13.1s]: hard cut, a medium shot of the bed with a window on the left: the one on the LEFT reaches over and hugs the one on the RIGHT from behind, cheek to cheek, eyes closed; the one on the RIGHT still scowls.
Shot 5 [13.1-15s]: hard cut, a tight close-up of their two faces pressed together: the scowl softens into a gentle smile and the eyes close.

No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music.

Anatomy rules: one head per animal, on its own body; paws, never human hands. No extra animals, no people, no text, no logo, no watermark.
